walk:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production oriented pixel-art WALK CYCLE sprite sheet for the reference king. Reference 1 determines exact character: gold crown, brown long hair and beard, burgundy tunic, silver pauldrons, navy trousers, brown tall boots, blue long cape and sheathed sword. Same coarse square-pixel style as reference, about 96px tall per character, NO antialiasing, clean solid opaque pixel silhouettes, NO glow or colored fringes, NO noise, NO detached particles.
Canvas square, exactly 4 columns and 2 rows, EIGHT full body frames ordered left to right then top to bottom. Every character faces RIGHT in the reference's slight three-quarter side view. Wide EMPTY transparent gutters between every frame. Full cape, crown, sword and boots fully within each cell. Fixed scale and pelvis horizontal position. Stationary in-place gait.
Frame sequence: 1 left leg forward right leg back contact; 2 lowering body weight; 3 right leg swings past left support leg; 4 rising on left toe; 5 right leg forward left leg back contact (opposite of frame 1); 6 lowering; 7 left leg swings past right support leg; 8 rising on right toe. Opposite arms swing naturally. Clearly differentiated poses. Cape changes subtly, no clothing drift. Legs must visibly alternate, not eight copies of one pose.
Background actual transparent alpha. No ground shadow. No text, lines, labels, numbers or borders. Palette from reference only.
run:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: RUN animation sprite sheet, EIGHT frames, exactly 4 columns and 2 rows, ordered left to right then top to bottom. Input reference defines the same king knight: tall gold crown, brown hair and full beard, silver shoulder armor, burgundy tunic, gold belt, navy trousers, tall brown boots, long blue cape, sheathed sword. Preserve reference's chunky square pixel art and limited palette.
EIGHT distinct poses of one continuous in-place RIGHT facing RUN cycle: 1 left foot contact, right leg far back; 2 left support knee compresses, right leg folds up behind; 3 right knee drives FORWARD high, left toe pushes back; 4 flight with right thigh forward left thigh back; 5 right foot contact left leg far back; 6 right support knee compresses left leg folds behind; 7 left knee drives forward high right toe pushes back; 8 opposite flight. All characters face RIGHT, torso leans slightly forward, elbows bent and swing opposite legs. Cape flies to LEFT. Do not repeat the same bent legs in all frames, show strong clear leg articulation and opposite leg phases.
Same character size, same fixed pelvis horizontal anchor per cell, full body and equipment contained well inside each cell with wide empty gutters. No cropped cape or sword. Simple flat hard edged pixel clusters, no antialiasing, no noise, no red or blue fringe, no detached pixels, no particles.
Transparent alpha background. No shadows, floor, text, grid lines, labels, frames, watermarks. This is a raw game sprite sheet, not a presentation.
